title: 建築の計画とデザイン
subtitle: Architectural Planning and Design
teachers:
SATO Kouichi
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal: Students gain not only an overview of the architectural field but also the expanse of the construction industry. Then they come to understand the importance of planning various elements of architecture that influence the consciousness and actions of people. Furthermore, throughout discussion with construction professionals, students develop their interest in architecture, cultivate a questioning attitude to problems, and acquire an ability to plan for the future.
advice:
This course explains not only the relationship between architectural planning and society but also the influence of architectural planning on town development and the landscape. Concretely, we presents students the goals of studying architecture by showing the superior instances of architecture and exterior spaces. Next, we expand the viewpoint of architectural planning to the fields of town development and landscapes. Furthermore, we show students various jobs related to architectural planning, and their awareness of architectural jobs and their morals grow.
The subjects of this course are as follows:
　1. Fields of architecture: first and eleventh lectures
　2. Design and history of architecture and exterior space: second to fifth lectures
　3. Areas covered by architectural planning: sixth to tenth lectures
　4. Jobs related to architectural planning: twelfth to fifteenth lectures
requiredKnowledge: It is important that students not only learn from the textbook of this course but also read as many books and magazines on architecture as possible. Furthermore, it is more important that students observe architecture and urban space in their daily lives. This attitude is needed for the four years of learning in this college as well as in this course.

achievementLevels.ideal: Students are strongly interested in superior architecture or townscapes, both in Japan and abroad, and are able to explain their distinctive features and significance. They are able to explain in detail ways that architectural planning influences the consciousness and actions of people. They are able not only to give basic explanations of construction-related jobs but also clearly display these learning targets in furthering their career development.
achievementLevels.standard: Students can explain the distinctive features and significance of superior architecture or townscapes in Japan and abroad. They are able to give rough explanations of how architectural planning influences the consciousness and actions of people. They can explain the basic jobs of construction.
